result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I did not add tests for the new matches, so the `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` and `-gradle.js` cases are not checked directly.

- **Generated HTML rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group was `(html|html|xhtml)`, so I changed it to `(html|htm|xhtml)`. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML rule:** the file pattern `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so it matches `MyAssembly.xml` instead of a file literally named `.xml`.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript rule:** the file pattern `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so it matches `app.js`.
- **Gradle JavaScript rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. The separate `.*[.]gradle` rule still covers `build.gradle`.

The content patterns are unchanged, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files only land in those scopes if they contain the generator markers.
